errors.description: The spread between the collar points measures about 122 degrees in frame against the drawn 100 degrees. Measured against its own family this inverts the ordering: the 115-degree Double Cut-Away 5.5 cm renders at about 102 degrees, i.e. NARROWER than this 100-degree option, so a customer comparing the two photographs side by side would read the two sizes backwards. This is a relative measurement across photographs shot in the same presentation, so it does not depend on assumptions about the drawing's projection.
errors.expected: 100 degrees, narrower than the 115-degree Double Cut-Away sibling
errors.actual: About 122 degrees, wider than the 115-degree sibling

notes: Attempt 3 of 3. The correction improved the spread substantially - attempt 2 opened to roughly 145 degrees, a near-horizontal extreme cutaway indistinguishable from the 145-degree Regular Collar 21 - but attempt 3 still lands about 22 degrees wide of the drawn 100 degrees, and attempt 1 was already at about 125 degrees, so the three attempts oscillated rather than converged. Attempt 3 is nonetheless the best of the three. Retry budget exhausted.
